title: From pair to peer programmer: Our vision for agentic workflows in GitHub Copilot
attributed_claim_summary: GitHub outlined a shift from autocomplete assistance to agents that independently execute and review multi-step work.
evidence_or_event: Source-authored report or launch; no original measurements collected in this repository.
limitations: Vision statement; not independent evidence that all workflow roles or projected benefits materialized.
research_relevance: AI-era coding workflow -> secure functionality -> independent reuse -> lifetime cost; distinguish release availability from observed adoption.
practical_experiment: Test review bottlenecks and task handoffs; retain humans as accountable approvers.
